raw_text: The Kakhovka hydroelectric dam in Russian-occupied southern Ukraine has been destroyed in what officials from both sides describe as a deliberate act. Thousands of residents face evacuation as floodwaters surge downstream. The dam supplied water to Crimea and cooled the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant. Environmental and humanitarian consequences expected to be severe.
